sections.title: Dilution
sections.excerpt:
DILUTION If
you purchase shares of our common stock in this offering, your interest will be diluted to the extent of the difference between the public
offering price per share and the pro forma as adjusted net tangible book value per share of our common stock immediately after this offering.
We calculate pro forma as adjusted net tangible book value per share by dividing our pro forma as adjusted net tangible book value, which
is total tangible assets less our total liabilities, by the number of our outstanding shares of common stock. Our
net tangible book value as of June 30, 2026, was approximately $3.2 million, or $0.21 per share. After giving effect to the issuance
of an aggregate of 943,676 shares of common stock in our August 2026 Offering, our pro forma net tangible book value as of June 30, 2026,
was approximately $6.1 million, or $0.38 per share. After
